scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,editor -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @weather-widget/api" "npm run dev -w @weather-widget/editor"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @weather-widget/shared && npm run build -w @weather-widget/embed && npm run build -w @weather-widget/editor && npm run build -w @weather-widget/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @weather-widget/shared && npm run test -w @weather-widget/api
